name: Merc Storia: Yujutsushi to Suzu no Shirabe
original_name: メルクストーリア - 癒術士と鈴のしらべ
source:
[b]Merc Storia: Yujutsushi to Suzu no Shirabe[/b] is an online free-to-play fantasy role-playing game created by Happy Elements. It was released in Japan in 2014 for Android and iOS devices. An anime adaptation by Encourage Films, [b]Merc Storia: Mukiryoku no Shounen to Bin no Naka no Shoujo[/b] aired from October 11 to December 27, 2018.

After the End of Service, Merc Storia received an offline version, making it a visual novel.
